End every sentence with the label of the chunk it comes from, written exactly as given, for example [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 37; c0412]. Where the rule above says NOT IN TEXT, reply exactly NOT IN CORPUS. When a chunk states what the company expects or plans, write that the document states it.

message.content: The indentures governing the senior notes contain provisions that allow for the incurrence of additional indebtedness, if after giving effect to such incurrence, the fixed charge coverage ratio (as defined in the respective indentures, which is a ratio of our consolidated EBITDA to fixed charges, including interest) for the trailing four quarter period on a pro forma basis would be at least 2.0 to 1.0 [boyd10q; Section I.2; c0426].
